gaps: No confirmed bulk, named, person-level download for any WV public college. WVU and Marshall run their own payroll and publish no salary lists. Would need to check the OpenGov grid in a browser for export, or file WV FOIA requests.
notes: wvcheckbook.gov is an OpenGov single-page app, so I listed its story pages and found the 'State of West Virginia Total Compensation' story, which embeds an OpenGov data grid. I couldn't confirm an export without a browser, so it is rated C. No news-organization database with downloads was found (searched Gazette-Mail and Mountain State Spotlight).
